description: React Native component for the checkout screen in a food delivery app, handling order summary, payment options, vouchers, tips, and map display.

methods.name: onCouponCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful coupon application, updates coupon state, and shows message.

methods.name: onCouponError
methods.description: Handles coupon application errors and shows message.

methods.name: calculateTip
methods.description: Calculates the tip amount based on selected tip or input.

methods.name: taxCalculation
methods.description: Calculates the tax amount based on restaurant tax rate and order amount.

methods.name: calculatePrice
methods.description: Calculates subtotal of cart items, applying discount if any, and including delivery charges.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates total order amount including subtotal, tax, tip, and discounts.

methods.name: validateOrder
methods.description: Validates order details before placing, including availability, minimum amount, address, payment method, and user verification.

methods.name: checkPaymentMethod
methods.description: Checks if the selected payment method supports the current currency.

methods.name: transformOrder
methods.description: Transforms cart items into order input format for mutation.

methods.name: onPayment
methods.description: Initiates order placement mutation based on payment method and order details.

methods.name: didFocus
methods.description: Fetches restaurant data, updates state, and transforms cart items for display.

methods.name: loadginScreen
methods.description: Displays placeholder loading UI while data is loading.
